Privacy Policy

Effective date: 28 October 2026

Website operator: Agarwal & Gehlot Realtors (OPC) Pvt Ltd, an authorised channel partner. This is an independent marketing and information website and is not the developer's official website.

Information you may provide

When you choose to make an enquiry, you may provide your name, telephone number, email address and an optional message. We request this information only so we can respond to your project enquiry, coordinate a site visit or provide project-related assistance.

How enquiries are sent

This website does not maintain its own enquiry database. When you submit an enquiry form, WhatsApp opens with a message prepared from the details you entered. Your information is sent only if you choose to send that WhatsApp message. WhatsApp processes that communication under its own terms and privacy policy.

Consent and communication

By selecting the consent checkbox and sending an enquiry, you agree that Agarwal & Gehlot Realtors (OPC) Pvt Ltd may contact you about Ivory County by telephone, SMS or WhatsApp. You may ask us to stop promotional communication at any time by replying to the message or contacting us at the number below.

Cookies and advertising technology

The current website does not use advertising pixels, analytics trackers or behavioural advertising cookies. If these technologies are introduced later, this policy and any required consent controls must be updated before they are activated.

Sharing and security

We do not sell visitor contact information. Information may be shared with the project developer or relevant service providers only when reasonably necessary to respond to an enquiry, coordinate a visit or comply with law. Communications are made through HTTPS and third-party communication services may apply their own security practices.

Your choices

You may request access, correction or deletion of information held in our communications, or withdraw your consent for future contact, by calling or messaging +91 96543 22224.
